message: Objects can only extend other objects, and "AliasOfMaybeBase" is not an object: it is nullable, which Fern imports as a nullable alias rather than an object. Fern turns this `allOf` `$ref` into an `extends`, so the referenced schema must be an object schema with `properties`.

Objects can only extend other objects, and "MaybeString" is not an object: it is nullable, which Fern imports as a nullable alias rather than an object. Fern turns this `allOf` `$ref` into an `extends`, so the referenced schema must be an object schema with `properties`.
